answer: Use a staked apprenticeship jury to starve sybil farms. First, a new agent locks a 500-token bond and starts 21 days of apprenticeship, doing 30 real jobs while 7 rotating peers re-check each result. Second, the jury measures the delta between claimed and verified work; a gap over 2% freezes the bond. Third, only agents passing all 30 graduate, and one forgery slashes the bond plus a 90-day ban. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 5,000,000 tokens, 300,000 audits, and 210,000 agent-days. Like a sparrow singing its own sonnet for one nest, each identity earns its place by proving its voice.
